title: Kerala Hills & Backwaters - 5 Days / 4 Nights (Demo)
summary: A five-day Kerala circuit combining the tea-country scenery of Munnar, a relaxed Thekkady stay and the backwaters of Alappuzha, with arrival and departure transfers in Kochi. This complete operator proposal is demonstration data for the TripRaft submission and review workflow; it is not an offer for sale or a confirmation of hotels, vehicles or availability.

itinerary.title: Kochi arrival and drive to Munnar
itinerary.details: Meet the operator representative at the agreed Kochi airport or city pickup point. Travel to Munnar with scheduled comfort stops and a scenic viewpoint stop if time and conditions permit. Check in, meet the local contact and keep the evening free to rest. This is a sample operating plan; pickup time and hotel voucher must be confirmed before travel.
itinerary.meals: Meals at own expense on arrival day.
itinerary.accommodation: Night 1 of 2 in a proposed 3-star Munnar hotel, standard twin-sharing room; property pending confirmation.

itinerary.title: Munnar tea country and local sightseeing
itinerary.details: After breakfast, take a locally guided tea-estate walk on an authorized route and visit a tea interpretation centre where operating. Continue to selected viewpoints with time for photographs and a local lunch stop. Return to the same hotel. Entrance permissions, opening hours and weather restrictions must be checked by the operator before confirmation.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast included; lunch and dinner at own expense.
itinerary.accommodation: Night 2 in the same proposed Munnar hotel, standard twin-sharing room.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady and a spice-garden visit
itinerary.details: Check out after breakfast and travel to Thekkady. After check-in and a rest break, join a sample guided spice-garden visit arranged by the operator. The evening is free for the local market. Wildlife boat trips and entertainment are optional and are not included or guaranteed by this proposal.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast included; lunch and dinner at own expense.
itinerary.accommodation: One night in a proposed 3-star Thekkady hotel, standard twin-sharing room; property pending confirmation.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alappuzha backwaters
itinerary.details: After breakfast, depart for Alappuzha with comfort stops. Check into a proposed lakeside or town hotel. In the afternoon, take the sample one-hour shared backwater cruise when the operator has verified the vessel, weather and service permissions. Return to the hotel for an unhurried evening. An overnight houseboat is not included.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast included; lunch and dinner at own expense.
itinerary.accommodation: One night in a proposed 3-star Alappuzha hotel, standard twin-sharing room; no overnight houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alappuzha to Kochi departure
itinerary.details: Breakfast and hotel checkout. Transfer to the agreed Kochi airport, railway station or city drop point. The final transfer time must allow a suitable buffer for the traveler departure and local traffic. The tour ends after the recorded drop-off; additional sightseeing and extended vehicle use are outside the sample inclusion.
itinerary.accommodation: Departure day; no overnight accommodation included.

inclusions: Four hotel nights in proposed standard twin-sharing rooms: Munnar 2, Thekkady 1, Alappuzha 1
Private air-conditioned road transfers for the stated route and operating hours, subject to vehicle confirmation
Sample guided tea-country walk and spice-garden visit with operator-arranged permissions
One-hour shared backwater cruise, subject to verified vessel and weather clearance
Road tolls, parking and driver allowance for the agreed itinerary
Operator coordination contact during the scheduled tour
exclusions: Flights or rail tickets to and from Kochi
Lunches, dinners, personal purchases, tips and optional activities
Travel insurance, medical expenses and unrelated transfers
Wildlife boat tickets, special permits and activities not expressly included
Early check-in, late checkout, room upgrades and extra vehicle hours
Public retail taxes or fees not yet configured by TripRaft; this is a private supplier proposal
transport_details: Sample private air-conditioned sedan for two adults with standard luggage; a larger vehicle must be quoted for larger parties. Seatbelts and a licensed local driver are required. Pickup/drop details, luggage limits, operator contact and vehicle confirmation must appear in the final voucher. The demo does not reserve a vehicle.
accessibility_notes: The sample route includes uneven paths, steps and vehicle transfers. Wheelchair-accessible rooms or transport are not confirmed. Ask the operator to assess mobility needs and provide verified arrangements before accepting a booking; activities can require an agreed alternative. Dietary and assistance requests require explicit confirmation.
cancellation_policy: DEMO POLICY FOR REVIEW TESTING ONLY. Cancellation more than 30 days before departure: sample refund 90%; 15-30 days: 70%; 7-14 days: 50%. Within 7 days or for a no-show, assess documented nonrecoverable service costs and applicable traveler rights rather than assuming a blanket exclusion. Cutoffs use Asia/Kolkata time. Operator cancellation requires a lawful refund or an acceptable verified alternative. TripRaft must review final terms and mandatory rights before any public offer.
safety_notes: Confirm traveler contact, operator duty contact, pickup identity and hotel vouchers before departure. Carry suitable clothing, drinking water and personal medication. Follow licensed guide and vessel safety instructions; do not proceed with unsafe weather, unapproved boats or unsupported accessibility arrangements. Report service shortfalls promptly through TripRaft support. This demo has no live supplier commitments or emergency service.

departures.notes: Sample supplier proposal: INR 18,500 per adult, twin sharing, minimum two adults. No confirmed inventory; retail price and tax treatment require TripRaft configuration.
